title: Incident Response: The Hospital
sensory_anchor: the pager that does not stop, the clock that is the patient's clock, the triage that is the same triage as a mass-casualty scene
emotional_signature: the clock is the patient's clock. the patient's clock is the only clock. she has been on the patient's clock before.
body: The hospital calls at 03:14. The hospital is a level-one trauma center in a mid-sized city. The hospital's network is down. The hospital's EHR is down. The hospital's imaging is down. The hospital's pharmacy is down. The hospital is operating on paper and pen and a generator that will run for sixteen more hours. The clock is the patient's clock. The patient's clock does not care that the forensic chain of custody takes twelve hours. The patient's clock is the same clock she has run on in mass-casualty scenes overseas. The clock is the clock that says: triage first, evidence second, the patient is the case. She triages. She does not triage the network. She triages the patient. The patient is the case. The case is: which systems need to come up in the next hour to keep patients alive. The answer is: pharmacy first, then EHR, then imaging. The lab can wait. The billing can wait. The answer is the answer she would give in a mass-casualty scene. The answer is the same answer. The patient does not care that the answer came from a Bureau agent. The patient cares that the answer came. The [DIRECTOR] is on the call. The [DIRECTOR] says: triage the case. The case is the patient. The case is also the network. The case is both. She runs the triage. She keeps the pharmacy up by isolating it from the rest of the network. She keeps the EHR up by restoring from the backup that the IT director thought was offline. The IT director was wrong. The IT director was wrong because the IT director had not read the room. The room was the backup. The backup was running. The backup was in the basement. The basement is read like a basement. The basement is read like a room. The hospital is back online in four hours. The forensic chain is preserved because the isolation was documented. The chain is documented because the documentation is the case. The case is both. The case is the patient and the network and the case file. The case file holds up in court. The patient is alive. The clock is the patient's clock. The patient's clock is the only clock.

title: Coordinating Field Teams from Behind a Screen
sensory_anchor: the headset that is not field comms, the screen that is not a window, the discipline of staying in the chair
emotional_signature: the field muscle wants to move. the muscle is the wrong muscle for this terrain. the discipline is staying in the chair.
body: The field team is in position. The field team is two blocks from the target's apartment. The field team is waiting for her call. The call is: go. The call is the call she would have made as a SEAL. The call is the call she would have made as a CT-Division field agent. The call is not the call she makes now. The call she makes now is: hold. The hold is the hold she made in RC-CT-002 and CT-007. The hold is the hold that the [DIRECTOR] taught her. The hold is the hold that costs her. The cost is: she is in the chair. The chair is behind a screen. The screen is not a window. The screen is the network. The network is the room. The room is the case. The field team is in the case. The case is the field team's target. The target is the operator of a network that has been hitting three defense contractors. The target is the operator's apartment. The apartment is the room. The room is read by the field team. The room is also read by her. The field team reads the door. She reads the network. The network is the same network that the field team cannot see. The network is the network that the target has on a laptop in the apartment. The laptop is on the network. The network is alive. The network will go dark the moment the field team kicks the door. The network going dark is fine if the network has been mirrored. The network has been mirrored. The mirror is the case. The case is what holds up in court. The mirror is what she has been building for nine weeks. The mirror is the Bureau's case. The field team kicks the door. The field team secures the target. The target's hands are visible. The target is not a threat. The laptop is in the evidence bag. The mirror is in the server room. The case is the mirror. The case is also the field team's arrest. The case is both. The case is both because she stayed in the chair. The chair is hard. The chair is the hardest place she has been. The chair is harder than BUD/S. The chair is harder than any field op. The chair is hard because the field muscle wants to move. The field muscle is the wrong muscle. The field muscle is not the muscle that builds mirrors. The muscle that builds mirrors is the muscle that stays in the chair. She has learned the muscle. The muscle is the Bureau's muscle. The muscle is hers now.

title: The Anomaly She Caught
sensory_anchor: the analyst's screen that is read as artifacts only, the pattern that is the person, the room that is read through the technical layer
emotional_signature: the room told her. the room has always told her. the room does not care what door she is reading. the room is a room.
body: The intrusion is at a financial services firm. The intrusion has been live for four months. The intrusion is sophisticated. The intrusion is the kind of sophisticated that the analysts have been working around the clock to attribute. The analysts are good. The analysts are reading the technical artifacts. The technical artifacts are: malware signatures, command-and-control infrastructure, the timing of exfiltration, the choice of targets within the firm's network. The artifacts are a wall. The artifacts are a wall the analysts cannot see over. The wall is not the wall she sees. The wall she sees is a person. The person is in the artifacts. The person is in the timing. The timing is: the operator exfiltrates data at 02:30 local time. The operator exfiltrates from the same subnet every time. The operator's choice of subnet is not a network choice. The subnet choice is a habit. The habit is a person. The person is the operator. The person is also: the operator takes weekends off. The operator's weekends are the same weekends every time. The operator's weekends are not the financial firm's weekends. The operator's weekends are the operator's country's weekends. The operator is in a country that is not the country the command-and-control infrastructure says. The infrastructure is the decoy. The weekends are the truth. She walks into the analyst's bullpen. She tells the analyst: pull the timestamps. The analyst pulls the timestamps. She tells the analyst: cross-reference the weekends. The analyst cross-references. The attribution is in the weekends. The attribution is also in the subnet choice. The subnet choice is a habit. Habits are persons. Persons are rooms. She reads the room. The room is a network. The room is a person. The room is the operator. The operator is in a country that the analysts had not considered. The operator is the case. The case is built on the pattern. The pattern is the room. The room is read. The [DIRECTOR] reads the case file. The [DIRECTOR] says: the analysts did not see it. She says: the analysts were reading the artifacts. The [DIRECTOR] says: you read the person. She says: persons are rooms. The [DIRECTOR] does not ask what rooms. The [DIRECTOR] has been in the rooms with her. The [DIRECTOR] has seen her read rooms since SEAL-006. The [DIRECTOR] has seen her read rooms since CT-004. The [DIRECTOR] has seen her read rooms since the stepfather's house. The [DIRECTOR] has never asked what rooms. The [DIRECTOR] does not need to ask. The [DIRECTOR] is in the rooms with her. The rooms are everywhere. The rooms are networks. The rooms are operations. The rooms are people. The rooms are the cases. The cases are the rooms. The rooms are read. The cases are built. The cases hold up in court. The cases hold up because the rooms are read. The rooms are read because she is the one who reads them. The reading is the tradecraft. The tradecraft is hers. The tradecraft has always been hers. The tradecraft is the same tradecraft she has had since the stepfather's house. The tradecraft is the same tradecraft. The doors are different. The doors are always different. The reading is the same. The reading is the case.

title: The Case That Broke the Pipeline
sensory_anchor: the case file that is twelve pages, the courtroom that holds, the director's voice that is the same voice the grandmother had
emotional_signature: the case is the case. the case is also the proof that the tradecraft is hers. the tradecraft is not going anywhere. the tradecraft is going with her when she leaves.
body: The case is two years. The case is two years of work. The case is the largest cyber operations case the task force has ever built. The case is built on the tradecraft. The tradecraft is the tradecraft she has had since the stepfather's house. The tradecraft is the tradecraft the [DIRECTOR] has seen her use since SEAL-006. The tradecraft is the tradecraft the [DIRECTOR] has been pointing at since CT-004. The tradecraft is hers. The case file is twelve pages. The case file is in court. The case file holds. The target is convicted. The conviction is a federal conviction. The conviction is the work of a Bureau-CIA task force. The conviction is also the work of a woman who learned tradecraft in a stepfather's house. The conviction is also the work of a woman who learned restraint in a grandmother's kitchen. The conviction is also the work of a woman who learned the difference between a threat and a problem from a [DIRECTOR] who would not let her kick down doors without warrants. The [DIRECTOR] is in the courtroom. The [DIRECTOR] is sitting behind her. The [DIRECTOR] does not speak. The [DIRECTOR] does not need to speak. The case file is the speech. The case file is twelve pages of speech. The case file holds. The [DIRECTOR] says: the case holds. She says: I know. The [DIRECTOR] says: what now. She says: the next case. The [DIRECTOR] says: after the next case. She does not say anything. She does not need to. The [DIRECTOR] already knows. The [DIRECTOR] has been in the room when she reads rooms. The [DIRECTOR] has been in the room when she counts exits. The [DIRECTOR] has been in the room when the tradecraft fires. The [DIRECTOR] has been in the rooms with her for thirteen years. The [DIRECTOR] is in the courtroom with her now. The courtroom is a room. The courtroom is read like a room. The courtroom holds. The case holds. The tradecraft holds. The tradecraft is going with her. The tradecraft is going with her when she leaves. The tradecraft is going to be in the next room she reads. The next room is not a courtroom. The next room is a kitchen. The next room is a kitchen with a newborn in it. The next room is a kitchen with a laptop and a baby monitor. The next room is the room the tradecraft has been pointing at since SEAL-006. The next room is the room the tradecraft was always going to. The next room is the room the tradecraft was always hers to read. The tradecraft is the same tradecraft. The doors are different. The doors are always different. The reading is the same. The reading is the case. The case holds. The case has always held. The case is going to keep holding. The case is going to hold in the next room. The next room is the room. The next room is the kitchen. The next room is hers.
